description: Set the default format order and explicit 3D permission. With filmId (use the filmId from list_releases), set that film's own order instead, which needs the film on your plan (set_tier first) and returns its plan with both ids. Formats left out rank after every listed one. Never books or modifies protected tickets.

filmId.description: Only this film's order: use the filmId from list_releases (the planner's own id works too).
